Made By Vet Nurses

SweetPea's Recipes

Our Veterinary nurse owners Claire and Lucy love dogs but share their passion about K9 nutrition!

We’re especially proud of our SweetPea's dog food range, created to bring together quality ingredients, great taste, and the kind of everyday nourishment dogs can truly enjoy.

We wanted to create a diet without any artificial colours or preservatives, no nasties, no cheap fillers and no small print! and this is it!

Every recipe is natural, balanced and complete, using British made ingredients. High meat/fish content, packed full of fruits, veggies and botanicals.

All our recipes are perfectly balanced to provide an optimum blend of nutrition and delicious taste.

On every bag of SweetPea's dry food

  • Grain Free
  • Hypoallergenic
  • Joint Support
  • Gently Steamed
  • Veg & Botanicals
  • High Meat & Fish
  • Omega 3 & 6
  • Skin & Coat

The SweetPea's Range

How delivery and collection works

We love it when you collect. Order online and pick up from our HQ in Tewkesbury, Bennetts Willow Barn in Worcester or any of our pop-up pitches. We also deliver the whole range locally, to homes within about 3 miles of one of our locations or pop-ups, free on orders over £35. Our 12kg bags of dry food are the only thing we post, and we send them anywhere in the UK.

Ordering

Food And Ordering Questions

Yes. We prefer orders to be collected where possible, but we deliver everything locally, including the 12kg and 2kg bags, wet food and deli treats, to homes within about 3 miles of one of our locations or pop-ups. Local delivery is free on orders over £35. Our 12kg bags of dry food are the only thing we post, and we send them anywhere in the UK.

Our two main collection points are our HQ at the rear of 25 High Street, Tewkesbury, or Bennetts Willow Barn, Worcester.

Or pop along to any of our regular pop-up pitches throughout Tewkesbury, Cheltenham & Worcester. The map and calendar on our homepage have the days and times.

Because we like to know who we are feeding. It also means your order is labelled and ready to go when you collect.

Chicken Dinner suits most dogs. Duck Roast is a good switch if chicken or beef do not agree with your dog, Salmon Supreme helps skin and coat, Lite Bite is lower in fat, and Big Paws has a larger kibble for bigger mouths. If you are not sure, message us and ask.

Standard 7 to 10 day transition schedule

  • Days 1 to 3: 75% old food + 25% new food
  • Days 4 to 6: 50% old food + 50% new food
  • Days 7 to 9: 25% old food + 75% new food
  • Day 10 onwards: 100% new food

Or get in touch for some more help or advice.
